**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Honor transient done-state expiry in the 3D client**

When a task succeeds, the runner emits `agent.status: done` but no later idle event. The 2.5D renderer handles the reducer's `renderAfter` effect and treats a done state older than three seconds as idle, while this loop handles only `toast`; consequently, the 3D character remains in its done pose with the completion marker indefinitely, until another task changes its status. Handle `renderAfter` here and apply the same age-based done-to-idle visual mapping used by the 2.5D renderer.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L11-L11](https://github.com/ehojune/bioinfo-team-3d/blob/d8b25ecf90fba59caea128c27a77839450bfadff/AGENTS.md#L11-L11)
